name: towercab-3d
description: 3D Tower Cab View for VATSIM Controllers

scripts.dev:server: pnpm run vite:build && set TOWERCAB_AUTO_SERVER=1 && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.dev.conf.json
scripts.build: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:converter && tauri build
scripts.build:fast: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:converter && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.fast.conf.json
scripts.build:vnas: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:converter && pnpm run lockfile:fresh && tauri build --features vnas
scripts.build:vnas:fast: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:converter && pnpm run lockfile:fresh && tauri build --features vnas --config src-tauri/tauri.fast.conf.json
scripts.build:vnas:nofresh: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:converter && tauri build --features vnas
scripts.build:vnas:fast:nofresh: pnpm run clean:dist && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build:converter && tauri build --features vnas --config src-tauri/tauri.fast.conf.json
scripts.update:vnas: cd src-tauri && cargo update -p towercab-3d-vnas && cd ..
